blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Truck operators hauling agricultural products have until Oct. 31 to enroll in a government program that would grant them a 5-percent discount on toll fees in November, intended to help alleviate logistics cost pressures amid still-elevated fuel prices. From Nov. 1 to 30, eligible agricultural truckers may avail of discounted toll fees on five expressways managed by SMC Tollways: the Skyway System, Naia Expressway, South Luzon Expressway, STAR Tollway, and Tarlac-Pangasinan-La Union Expressway.
